description: Concerts and comedy this Friday through Sunday (the remaining or upcoming weekend) in Boston (default) or Denver (city=denver). Use this for “what's on this weekend?”. Default sort=evening. free=true, event_type=comedy, and genre= match tonight/search. For “what should I see this weekend?” or date night prefer list_picks. Always cite `url` (`/e/?id=`). Do not rewrite to /event/. Paginated: default 20, max 50, always includes total.

area.description: Finder WHERE pill or neighborhood (Boston: cambridge, allston_brighton, somerville…; Denver: den_downtown, den_colfax, boulder…). Aliases: neighborhood, where.

city.description: boston (default: Boston, Cambridge, Somerville, Greater Boston) or denver (Denver, Boulder, the Colorado Front Range). Set denver for anything in Colorado.

event_type.description: comedy, theatre or music. Comedy is public event_type / finder ty=c, theatre (plays and musicals) is ty=t; neither is a genre tag. Use for “comedy this week?” or “what plays are on?”.

free.description: If true, only free shows (listing flag or price 0). Use for “what’s free tonight?”. Alias: is_free.

genre.description: Finder mega-category (rock, punk, pop, jazz, soul, blues, folk, electronic, hiphop, reggae, classical, latin). Alias: genres. Comedy is event_type, not a genre. Joined from finder.json `g` — do not invent tags.

intimate.description: Hint alias of max_capacity=500. Unknown capacity excluded.

is_free.description: If true, only free shows (listing flag or price 0). Use for “what’s free tonight?”. Alias: is_free.

limit.description: Page size. Default 20, max 50. Do not request the full list — tonight is ~174 shows / ~36k tokens.

max_capacity.description: Known venues.json capacity ≤ N. intimate=true aliases max_capacity=500 (hint, not a stored flag).

max_price.description: Numeric price ceiling. Free passes; unknown price excluded.

mbta.description: Boston only. If true, only MBTA-accessible rooms.

min_capacity.description: Known venues.json capacity ≥ N. large=true aliases min_capacity=5000.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use with the returned total to page.

sort.description: evening (default): evening + upcoming first, not brunch-first chrono. time: raw chronological. popular: editorial picks first, then evening.

via.description: Inbound UTM source written onto every Foobos deep link. Default muse.
